text:
Jake (Sales): Quick handoff for Celestia Health — contract signed yesterday. High-level: onboarding broadly on-track but two blockers: SSO (Okta SAML) and a schema mismatch on batch ingestion. Renewal: 2026-01-31 (12mo). Committed seat: Dedicated-50k/mo. Primary contacts: Priya (IT) <priya@celestia.com>, Ben (PM). Delivery target: live pilot in us-west by end of month, eventual Private deployment. Asking CS to own the kickoff and coordinate support/eng for blockers.

Maria (CS): Thanks Jake — picking this up. Current onboarding status: account provisioning ✅, API keys issued ✅, smoke tests passed on hosted, dev sandbox seeded (15k rows) — onboarding progress ~65%. Blockers:
- SSO: customer needs metadata exchange and test user mapping
- Batch ingestion: their events payload has nested arrays for `observations` which causes our parser to fail on field types (int vs string)

Raj (CS Lead): @Maria assign CSM and set kickoff. I can run the initial call Wed 10am PT if that works for Celestia. Also marking renewal risk LOW but watch usage during pilot.

Tess (Support): I will open a support case for the SSO setup. @Priya please share SAML metadata (entityID, ACS URL) and a test account for validation. Also tagging this as P1 for onboarding until SSO is validated.

Sam (Eng): I can take the ingestion schema issue. Can you drop a sample payload and the error log? Example of the failing structure would help. If it's nested arrays we may need a small transform or a tolerance mapper on our side.

Jake (Sales): Priya said they can do a SAML metadata dump today and will send a sample payload from their ETL team. They prefer Friday for a deeper technical sync.

Maria (CS): Timeline proposal and owners: 
- SSO metadata exchange & test user: Tess (Support) owner, target 48h
- Schema mapping + transformation plan: Sam (Eng) owner, target 72h after sample received
- Kickoff + product walkthrough: Raj (CS Lead) owner, schedule Wed 10am PT (tentative)
- Pilot success metrics doc and eval prompts: Maria (CS) owner, draft by next Tue

Tess (Support): Created ticket #SUP-3142 and added Celestia contact. Ask: can someone from infra share our SAML expected attributes mapping? Quick snippet below for what we expect: 

```
Expected SAML attributes:\n- NameID (email)\n- firstName\n- lastName\n- groups (optional)
```

Sam (Eng): Paste of sample payload would be ideal like: 
```
{
  "patient_id": "abc123",
  "observations": [[{"type":"bp","value":"120/80"}], [{"type":"temp","value":98.6}]]
}
```
I can prototype a tolerant parser to flatten nested arrays within 24-48h once I have the real sample.

Maria (CS): Also capturing enablement ask: they want a 30-min training for the PM + 2 engineers on query tuning and embeddings. I'm scheduling that for next Tue 2pm PT — will confirm after kickoff.

Raj (CS Lead): Escalation map (quick):
- For SSO auth failures -> Tess (Support) -> oncall-bot if >24h
- For ingestion/parsing -> Sam (Eng) -> eng-oncall if prod regression
- For contract/renewal questions -> Jake (Sales) -> Raj (CS Lead) for retention play

oncall-bot: NOTE: Creating alert rule template for onboarding SSO tickets tagged P1.

Tess (Support): Quick question — do we have a sandbox SP entity we can share or do we need to configure on their Okta instance?

Sam (Eng): We have a test SP at sso-test.redwood.internal — I'll share metadata in DM.

Maria (CS): Next actions (owners & due):
1) Tess: confirm SAML metadata exchange + create support ticket (due 48h)
2) Sam: review sample payload + propose transform (due 72h after sample)
3) Raj: confirm kickoff time with Celestia and send calendar invite (due EOD today)
4) Maria: draft pilot success metrics + enablement invite (due next Tue)
5) Jake: follow up with Priya for sample payload + SAML dump (due EOD today)

Jake (Sales): I'll ping Priya now and post updates here. :thumbsup:

Maria (CS): Thanks everyone — I'll post a single-threaded status update after each owner completes their step to keep things tidy.

Tess (Support): Logged initial investigation notes in #SUP-3142. Adding tags: onboarding, sso, celestia.

Sam (Eng): I'll monitor the ticket and open a PR for a tolerant mapper if needed.

Raj (CS Lead): Great — moving to action. If anything blocks, escalate to me and I'll pull in account execs.

Jake (Sales): Update: Priya just shared SAML metadata link and said ETL will send sample by EOD. Pls watch ticket.

Maria (CS): Received — closing the loop here. Will update thread as things progress. :rocket:
